palette.board: dark olive-green chalkboard #484828..#485828 ~36% at final framing

content: Original: a prehistoric-style classroom — large wood-framed chalkboard upper-centre, two small hand-drawn wall posters left and right (original images/words), rows of small wooden desks with stools in the foreground, a stone lectern at right with an original teacher character standing behind it (head and shoulders visible; any original design, e.g. a bald elder with a long white moustache). On the board, handwritten chalk-white cursive text: "topic: sabre cat".
timeline: f0: hard cut to the WIDE classroom (board + posters + desks + lectern + teacher all visible).

f6-58 (about 53 frames): CAMERA PUSH-IN towards the board text and the teacher: total scale factor ~1.70 (content grows to 170%), ease-in-out (slow start, fastest around f30-34, slow settle), with a simultaneous pan so that content moves LEFT by ~670 px total (camera moves right, towards the teacher); ends framing the board text across the frame with the teacher at the right edge.

f59-178: no camera motion. The teacher lifts a thin stick pointer and taps/points at the text: pointer changes position in several discrete steps (pose swaps, 1-2 frames each) 3-5 times; mouth open/closed swaps allowed.

style.line: thick near-black (#080808..#202020) hand-drawn outlines, slightly uneven width 4-7px at 1080p; flat fills, at most a light hand-shaded texture; no gradients, no glow, no drop shadows
style.typography: handwritten / marker-style lowercase labels (font UNKNOWN in source; use any handwritten-looking font or draw strokes); never a geometric sans
style.originality: ALL characters, creatures, wording and objects must be NEW and original as specified here; do not imitate any existing show

deliverables: timeline.json: frame indices you used for every event
rules: You see only this spec. No source frames are provided or allowed. Use python3 + numpy + opencv (venv at ~/YIOS-local-audits/tooling/visual-ct-scan-venv/bin/python3) and ffmpeg (h264, yuv420p).
